mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW X4 M40i engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rebuilt B58 engine for the BMW X4 M40i typically costs £4,500-£8,500 supply-only, depending on the exact B58 variant and specification. Specialist fitting adds £650-£910 (10-14 hours labour at independent rates). Main dealer replacement can be significantly higher - often £9,000+ for a new engine.

mainEntity.name: Is the BMW X4 M40i B58 engine reliable for high mileage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The B58 is widely considered BMW's most reliable modern six-cylinder petrol engine. With proper maintenance, it routinely exceeds 150,000-200,000 miles without major failures. Closed-deck block design provides exceptional strength, with common minor issues limited to oil filter housing leaks, coolant cap failure, and PCV valve.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of B58 oil filter housing failure in an X4 M40i?

acceptedAnswer.text: The plastic oil filter housing in the B58 can become brittle and develop cracks, leading to oil or coolant leaks. Look for oil spots under the car, low oil levels between services, or coolant loss without visible external leaks. Housing replacement at a specialist costs £900-£1,500.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine on a high-mileage BMW X4 M40i?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the body and transmission are sound. A £4,500-£8,500 rebuilt B58 engine can add 100,000+ miles to a well-maintained X4 M40i - far cheaper than replacing the whole vehicle, which typically retains strong value at £18,000+.

mainEntity.name: Does BMW X4 M40i engine replacement include ISN coding and ECU matching?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional replacement includes ISN (Individual Serial Number) coding to match the replacement engine to your X4 M40i's immobiliser and ECU. Without correct coding, the immobiliser will prevent engine operation. All EnginesMarket specialists include ISN matching and DDE calibration.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the X4 M40i and X4 M40i MHT engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: The X4 M40i MHT (2021-2024) adds a 48V mild hybrid system with an 11hp electric boost and coasting functionality. The base B58 engine remains fundamentally the same, but the MHT system adds complexity. MHT engine replacement requires professional 48V system isolation.

commonProblems.h2: BMW X4 M40i Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The B58 engine in the BMW X4 M40i is widely regarded as one of BMW's most reliable modern straight-sixes, with many examples exceeding 150,000 miles without major failures. However, several well-documented weak points - particularly around the cooling system and oil filter housing - can lead to costly repairs if not caught early. Every rebuilt B58 engine supplied through EnginesMarket includes upgraded components designed to address these failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: B58 Oil Filter Housing Leak - Why the BMW X4 M40i's Plastic Housing Fails
problems.rootCause: The B58's plastic oil filter housing can become brittle with age and heat cycling, leading to cracking and oil or coolant leaks. The cartridge-style filter design and overtightening of the filter cap during oil changes accelerate the problem .

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace plastic housing with updated unit, new gaskets, oil change
repairOptions.longevity: 80,000+ miles; permanent fix with revised part

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt B58 with upgraded housing and cooling components
repairOptions.longevity: If housing failure caused engine damage or high mileage rebuild justified

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW X4 M40i (2018-2024) retains strong value, with examples ranging from £18,000-£45,000 depending on mileage and condition. Replacement cost is typically small relative to vehicle value; well-maintained M40is justify rebuilt engine investment.
problems.recommendation: Oil filter housing replacement at a specialist is far cheaper than dealer pricing and addresses the issue permanently with updated parts. If caught early, there's no need to replace the whole engine. However, if the housing failure has caused oil starvation and bearing damage, a full rebuilt engine with upgraded components is the only safe route.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B58 BMW X4 M40i engine prices

problems.h4: B58 Coolant System Failures - Why X4 M40i Owners Shouldn't Ignore Coolant Loss
problems.rootCause: The B58's plastic water pump and expansion tank components can crack or fail, leading to coolant loss and potential overheating. The expansion tank cap's pressure seal is a known weak point .

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace expansion tank cap with updated design
repairOptions.longevity: Permanent fix if caught before overheating

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace water pump, thermostat, gaskets, coolant flush
Supply & fit rebuilt B58 with upgraded cooling components
repairOptions.longevity: If overheating caused head gasket or bottom-end failure

problems.vehicleValueCheck: With M40i values typically £18,000+, a rebuilt engine at £4,500-£8,500 remains a viable investment if the car is otherwise sound - particularly for owners planning long-term retention.
problems.recommendation: Never ignore coolant loss on a B58. Replace the expansion tank cap as a first step and pressure-test the system. If the water pump shows signs of weep or failure, replace it preventatively at a specialist. On a high-mileage M40i, a rebuilt engine with upgraded cooling components may be better value than repairing a compromised unit.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B58 engine prices for BMW X4 M40i

problems.h4: B58 PCV System Failure - Why Integrated Valve Cover Replacement Is Costly
problems.rootCause: The PCV valve is integrated into the plastic valve cover on B58 engines. When the diaphragm fails, it causes a high-pitched whistling noise, oil consumption, and can pressurise the crankcase .

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Complete valve cover (PCV integrated), new gaskets, spark plug seals
Supply & fit rebuilt B58 with upgraded PCV components
repairOptions.longevity: If crankcase pressurisation caused oil seal failure

problems.vehicleValueCheck: On an M40i worth £18,000+, a £550-£850 specialist repair is a modest outlay relative to vehicle value; replacement is strongly recommended if the PCV fails.
problems.recommendation: If you hear a whistling sound from the engine bay, the PCV valve has almost certainly failed. On B58 engines, this means replacing the entire valve cover assembly - use a specialist to save £300-£500 versus dealer pricing. Don't delay; crankcase pressure can force oil past seals, causing further damage.
